meta.title: Convert to Auction is offered on a live RFQ where Vendor An and Vendor B have bid

plan.title: Convert to Auction offered on live RFQ

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with the existing bids on its summary page.
Open the stage Settings menu where conversion actions are offered.
Assert that Convert to Auction is present and clickable for the live RFQ.
Reopen the Settings menu after the menu assertion closed it.
Select the conversion action to verify it opens a confirmation window.
Assert that the conversion window opened before any confirmation is made.
Cancel the conversion so the event remains unchanged.
Assert that the conversion window closed after cancellation.
